caseName: Fitzgerald, Treasurer of Iowa v. Racing Association of Central Iowa
caseNameFull: Fitzgerald, Treasurer of Iowa v. Racing Association of Central Iowa Et Al.

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Iowa. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioner is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, March 3, 2003. Brief of respondents is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Wednesday, April 2, 2003. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, April 21, 2003. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply
